Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Inquiries About WhatsApp API

Find comprehensive answers to setup requirements, message costs, and CRM connections.

The WhatsApp Business API is a developer platform designed for medium and large companies to automate conversations, connect CRM systems, and send bulk notification broadcasts at scale. It requires approval from Meta and utilizes authorized API servers.

The standard app is free for small local businesses, limited to 1 user or few connected devices, and does not support custom database CRM integrations, multi-agent chatbots, or automated broadcast campaigns. The API removes these limits and enables advanced workflow automation.

Only business-initiated outbound template messages (like broadcasts, payment reminders, or shipping updates) require prior approval from Meta. Inbound replies or user-initiated conversations can be fully custom without template approval.

By using the official Meta WhatsApp Business API and complying with Meta's guidelines (permission-based messaging, high-quality template updates), your number remains secure from blocks. We handle the entire compliance routing setup.

Yes, we integrate WhatsApp API flows directly with major CRMs (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce) and sheets. This allows your team to view chat histories and update lead status directly inside your CRM.

Absolutely. Our triage systems are built for seamless agent handover. Whenever a user requests a human agent or answers a complex support query, the system instantly alerts your support team and assigns the chat to a live inbox.

Meta categorizes API accounts into messaging tiers starting at 1,000 unique customers per day, scaling up to 10,000, 100,000, and unlimited. The tier automatically upgrades based on message volume and quality scores.

Yes, we build a multi-agent shared team inbox dashboard. This allows your sales, support, and billing teams to log in simultaneously, manage chats, assign tickets, and view analytics reports.

Yes, we integrate the API with scheduling engines (Google Calendar, Calendly). The chatbot checks real-time availability, displays slots, books appointments, and triggers follow-up reminders.

Meta charges on a 24-hour conversation window basis. The pricing varies by region and category (Marketing, Utility, Authentication, Service). We will audit your usage and set up the most cost-efficient structure.

Yes. The API supports rich media attachments including high-res product catalogs, images, PDF brochures, video guides, and interactive buttons.

Yes. All conversations are end-to-end encrypted through Meta API routing. We follow secure customer database structures and permission-based opt-in flows to ensure compliance with GDPR and local data privacy laws.

Yes, we build custom AI chatbots powered by OpenAI's GPT models. We train the AI on your business database, FAQ lists, and product catalogs to provide highly accurate, human-like answers.

Yes, we integrate WhatsApp flows directly with Shopify and WooCommerce to trigger automated alerts for abandoned carts, order status updates, and tracking details.

Setting up the API, getting Meta credentials approved, and launching basic greeting/routing flows typically takes 7 to 10 business days. Custom AI database chatbots require 2 to 3 weeks.

Yes, we assist in submitting your business profile to Meta for verification. Meta reviews factors like brand authority, search index listings, and API usage history to grant the official green checkmark badge.

Yes, the system can monitor unpaid invoice deadlines in your billing software and automatically broadcast reminders along with payment gateway links.

Yes, you can broadcast promotional offers, coupon codes, and festival greetings to customers who have opted-in to receive updates.

Our dashboard reports real-time statistics for message delivery rates, read rates, click-through rates, average customer response times, chatbot conversion rates, and agent metrics.

Yes, we offer ongoing maintenance packages. We update template scripts, audit conversation charges to optimize costs, retrain AI chatbot models, and update CRM integrations monthly.
